· Current price ($80.22) vs SMA5 ($78.08)/SMA20 ($74.25)/SMA50 ($74.59) — Confirms short-to-mid-term trend is upward.
· Below SMA100 ($83.25)/SMA200 ($88.73) — Indicates mid-to-long-term trend is in a weak phase.
· 52-week position (24.6%) + Current price level is near historical lows.

· RSI trajectory (51.3→63.9) — Exited oversold territory and is now consolidating in the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6334→0.8059) — Improving, signaling expanding bullish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper Band $79.92) — Breakout above the upper band, with band width at 15.28% indicating expansion.

· Swing Resistance ($84.66) — Based on the 5-day high and R1 pivot.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low continuation) — Reinforces the uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.00x) — Normal level, maintaining confidence in the price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Position target of 1x filled, next card is leverage.
